snippet.title: LOST ZION announcement TRAILER
snippet.description:
WHISLIST ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4456550/LOST_ZION
LOST ZION is an Environmental HORROR game in the style of Blade Runner, Tron and Cyberpunk. It's not only walking around, there is massive deep LORE in the CITY of LOST ZION, many horrific interactions, epic cinematics. 

The CITY is massive and everything will make sense. ONE DIRECTIVE HAS BEEN INITIATED. ACTIVATE THE GRAVITY CORE!
---------------------------- THIS GAME IS NOT AN OPEN WORLD (yet) ----------------

This is my 1st GAME developed and released SOON (2026) on STEAM. 
GAMER AT HEART many many years waited for this moment. 
SUBSCRIBE and tra-la-la if you enjoy. WISHLIST IT ON STEAM PLEASE
